messages:
maria_support: FYI — Blockade Therapeutics (POKID BK-9921) says procurement will not accept any invoice without an official PO number and their cost-center code. They specifically call out Coupa rejects. Billing says we can’t issue invoice until PO arrives. What’s the fastest path?
jason_sales: tagging @olivia_accounting and @emma_finance. They have an executed MSA but procurement is strict. I can ping their procurement lead for a PO template — raj@blockade.com — can we provide a proforma meantime?
olivia_accounting: We can provide a proforma/estimate but cannot issue an official invoice until we have the customer PO per enterprise billing policy. Proforma should clearly state "invoice contingent on PO". Also need the PO to include their cost_center and reqid so it maps to their Coupa process.
maria_support: Customer says Coupa returns: `Missing required field: bill_to` and rejects upload when `reqid` missing. They asked if we can add a `client_req_id` header on invoices.
emma_finance: We can include a custom invoice header `client_req_id` and a separate line for cost_center but need the exact key names they expect. If this is EU customer, we also need their VAT ID to zero-rate VAT.
jason_sales: Raj — can you attach the PO template or a screenshot of the Coupa error here so we can validate? Also, can you confirm the cost_center format (numeric vs dashed)? @raj_at-customer
raj_at-customer: attaching screenshot — Coupa rejects our upload with error: "Invalid cost center format". They require `42-77` style. We can issue a PO once you give line-item breakdown (hosted vs dedicated capacity) and an estimated total.
maria_support: I'll draft line-item breakdown. Do they want the SOW split on the invoice or separate lines per product? They asked for Hosted, Dedicated, and Optimize as separate lines.
olivia_accounting: Yes — split hosted/dedicated/optimize lines. Include unit qty and unit price. Add VAT section that we can populate once VAT ID is provided. If the PO amount differs from final invoice we may need approval cycle, which could delay billing.
procurement_helm_bot: Heads up: per internal policy we cannot create a final invoice until a valid customer PO is on file. See https://redwood/internal/billing/po-policy :thumbsup:
jason_sales: I'll request PO with cost_center `42-77` format and VAT ID. I'll also ask for Coupa XML if they can export it; that speeds validation.
maria_support: If they send Coupa XML, ping #support and I’ll run validation: `python tools/validate_coupa_po.py --input po.xml`. Quick note: the validator checks for `bill_to`, `reqid`, `cost_center`, and `line_item[].description`.
emma_finance: Operationally, once PO is received and matches amounts, expect invoice issuance within 1 business day. If values differ or mandatory fields missing, we’ll hold and escalate.
jason_sales: Thanks — I’ll follow up with Raj and attach their PO XML if we get it. Will update here. :thumbsup:
maria_support: Great, thanks everyone. Leaving a checklist for follow-up: 1) Sales requests PO with cost_center and VAT ID, 2) Sales attaches Coupa XML/screenshot, 3) Support runs validator and confirms mapping, 4) Accounting issues invoice after PO match.
raj_at-customer: Thanks — we’ll try to get the PO out EOD once you provide the line-item breakdown.
maria_support: Copy that — preparing breakdown now and will post draft in thread shortly.
